stack_spec.name: Spec4
stack_spec.description: A locally-served, developer-facing pipeline app (Dash + Dash Mantine Components) that turns a rough idea or existing codebase into a versioned folder of specs. This round extends the v0 dev-tool register to the chat frame and adds the Artifact View screen (with round-tree-driven navigation into it), reading and rendering artifact files using only the Python standard library and existing DMC/Dash primitives — no new dependency of any kind.

languages.name: Python
languages.role: Dash application server, callbacks, and UI layout composition (backend and server-rendered UI are one deployable)
languages.trailing_commas: in multi-line collections and function calls

languages.name: CSS
languages.role: shell, theme, and project-view spacing/density styling; hand-authored, no preprocessor, no new build tooling
languages.quotes: double (for consistency with the rest of the codebase)

naming_conventions.files: snake_case (v3.css retained as the single stylesheet)

targets.name: spec4_app
targets.purpose: the single local Dash application: serves the UI (status bar, project view, round tree, agent rows, chat frame, and now Artifact View) and runs the pipeline-agent backend in one process
targets.runtime: Python 3.12, served via gunicorn (production-style local serving) or the Dash dev server (DASH_DEBUG=true)
targets.hosting: local machine only, at localhost:8050; no cloud hosting, no multi-tenant deployment
targets.distribution: run locally via the `spec4` CLI entrypoint, `uv run python src/spec4/app.py`, or gunicorn per the existing Makefile `deploy` target

exposure.transport: HTTP on localhost only; not exposed beyond the local machine

libraries.name: Dash
libraries.purpose: core web application framework serving both the UI and its server-side callbacks; this round's new Artifact View reuses Dash core's dcc.Location for round/file selection routing and dcc.Download + dcc.send_file/send_string (already part of Dash core, no new dependency) to back the Artifact View's Download button and the chat frame's new 'Open' links

libraries.name: Dash Mantine Components
libraries.purpose: the sole UI component layer; this round's Artifact View (round selector, reused round tree, content pane header) and restyled chat frame (plain-text pill bar, block transcript, outline action row) are built entirely from existing DMC primitives (e.g. dmc.Code/html.Pre + dmc.ScrollArea) with line numbers computed via simple string/enumerate logic — no CodeHighlight or other syntax-highlighter component is introduced, per this round's no-new-dependency constraint; the accent remains the single Mantine theme primary throughout

libraries.name: dash-iconify
libraries.purpose: icon components used in place of the removed emoji throughout the shell and rows; unchanged this round

libraries.name: litellm
libraries.purpose: multi-provider LLM gateway used by the seven pipeline agents; unchanged this round

libraries.name: mcp
libraries.purpose: Model Context Protocol client SDK used elsewhere in the pipeline; unchanged this round

libraries.name: boto3
libraries.purpose: AWS SDK supporting litellm's optional Bedrock/SageMaker routing; unchanged this round

libraries.name: httpx
libraries.purpose: general HTTP client used across the app; unchanged this round

libraries.name: jsonschema
libraries.purpose: validates artifact JSON files against their schemas; unchanged this round

libraries.name: gunicorn
libraries.purpose: production-style WSGI server for local deployment; unchanged this round

libraries.name: pyyaml
libraries.purpose: YAML parsing used elsewhere in the pipeline; unchanged this round

libraries.name: mypy
libraries.purpose: strict static type checking across the codebase; unchanged this round

libraries.name: types-pyyaml
libraries.purpose: type stubs for pyyaml, required for mypy strict mode; unchanged this round

libraries.name: pytest
libraries.purpose: test runner for the existing suite (agents, layouts, callbacks, session, project-manager) plus this round's Artifact View path-confinement and rendering tests

libraries.name: pytest-cov
libraries.purpose: coverage measurement for the pytest suite; unchanged this round

libraries.name: Playwright
libraries.purpose: browser automation for end-to-end verification, extended this round to cover Artifact View navigation and the restyled chat frame

libraries.name: Ruff
libraries.purpose: linting (and formatting via ruff format) for all Python source; unchanged this round

artifact_store.choice: local filesystem JSON files under .spec4/v{N}/, one file per artifact, produced by the pipeline agents
artifact_store.purpose: source of truth for every Artifact and UsageRecord this round's screens read, now including the Artifact View; reads are resolved strictly against the existing reviewed artifact table / dependency graph in project_manager.py using stdlib path resolution (pathlib) only — no path outside .spec4/ is ever reachable, and no new dependency is introduced to do this
artifact_store.durability: source of truth for artifact content; survives restarts and is unaffected by browser state

collections.name: round_artifacts
physical: one file per artifact under .spec4/v{N}/, path fixed by pipeline order; status derived live from the existing dependency graph (mtime comparison against upstream artifacts); the same reviewed artifact table is now also the sole source of files reachable through the Artifact View, across all rounds on disk

collections.name: usage_records
collections.purpose: per-round usage/cost rollup; deliberately excluded from the artifact dependency graph and never marked needs-update; also now the source for the chat frame's on-completion cost strip
physical: usage.json, one per round, per-agent model/tokens/cost totals

browser_store.choice: existing browser dcc.Store pair — sessionStorage (session) and localStorage (prefs); no server-side session
browser_store.purpose: remembers the working directory and default provider/model across navigations and, for prefs, across browser sessions on the same machine, without any state touching the server or disk; unchanged mechanism this round
browser_store.durability: session store is cleared when the tab closes (not durable); prefs store persists on-device across sessions but is not backed up or synced

collections.name: prefs_store
physical: localStorage, read via callback State; BYOK provider keys live here client-side only and never reach the server or disk

patterns: Dash Mantine Components remains the sole UI/component layer for this round; no React, Tailwind, or other new front-end dependency is introduced
layout helpers in layouts/_shared.py (e.g. _card, cost_summary_card) are reused rather than duplicated, including by the Artifact View's content-pane header
agent pipeline order is defined once in app_constants.AGENT_KEYS; all agent-ordered tables (round tree, agent rows, chat frame pill bar) are derived from or asserted against it
status (artifact presence/staleness, agent action, cost) is recomputed from the existing dependency graph and usage.json on every render, never cached
existing component ids are kept as a test contract, except the removed Back buttons, whose tests are updated; new components (Artifact View, Open links) get new ids rather than renaming existing ones
the accent color is set once as the Mantine theme primary; components inherit it rather than setting color locally

Artifact View reads and renders files using only the Python standard library (json for pretty-printing, pathlib for confined path resolution) plus existing DMC/Dash primitives; no Markdown renderer and no syntax-highlighter dependency is introduced — line numbers are computed by simple enumeration over the file's text
the round tree rendering logic is factored into a function shared by the project view and the Artifact View, rather than duplicated
documentation: design decisions recorded as numbered comments (D-XX) at the point of implementation, per existing convention

project_structure.purpose: Dash Mantine layout components; shell, status bar, project view, round tree, agent rows, chat frame, and the new Artifact View are built here

new: the Artifact View screen — round selector, reused round tree, and content pane (one-line monospace header plus pretty-printed JSON or line-numbered plain text, rendered via stdlib json/pathlib and existing DMC primitives, no syntax highlighter); wires the Download button and, for design/mock.html, the 'Open rendered' button
existing chat frame layout, restyled this round: plain-text pill bar, block-style transcript, outline-style action row with Open buttons beside Download, and removal of all Back controls
reusable layout helpers (cards, cost summary, round tree) shared across the project view, chat frame, and Artifact View

Dash server-side callbacks; this round adds callbacks for Artifact View routing/read (round + file selection, confinement check) and for the new 'Open X' links in the chat frame's action row and round tree
single stylesheet; this round's chat-frame block/transcript styling and Artifact View content-pane spacing land here

existing artifact dependency graph, staleness detection, and agent button state; now also the single source of the reviewed artifact table the Artifact View resolves file requests against (strictly under .spec4/), and of the rounds-on-disk enumeration for the round selector
session defaults and artifact persistence; source of working-directory and round state, including the Artifact View's default round
per-agent model resolution shared by the gate card, model chip, and retry panel; status bar reads the default provider/model from here; unchanged this round
single source of the seven-agent pipeline order (AGENT_KEYS), used by the round tree, agent rows, and the chat frame's restyled pill bar

pytest suite mirroring src/ layout; includes callback co-presence and component-ordering contract tests, extended this round with Artifact View path-confinement tests and updated Back-button-removal tests
